summary: Names the thing to recolour on the search-and-recolor endpoint. `select_prompt` picks the object out of the image; `prompt` describes the colour or finish it should end up with.
combines: Worked example: select_prompt 'jacket' with a prompt describing the new colour.
Recolour keeps the object's shape and texture and changes its appearance, unlike search-and-replace which substitutes the object outright.
The AWS mirror's wording for this field and for search_prompt is transposed; the endpoint each belongs to is what disambiguates them.
note: Search-and-recolor edit operation; not implemented in this iteration.
